newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds firmness but trading thin.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds firmness but trading thin.

text.p: White sugar futures managed to hold most of their earlier firmness on Monday but ranges and overall volume were both thin given the absence of major players.
Commission houses were the dominant force on the nearby months and were said to have been on both sides of the market, with scale-up sell orders in place just above current levels.
At 1540 GMT August was up 10 cents at $318.40 and October up 20 cents at $308.00. Volume was 457 lots.
Arbitrage and switch trading was patchy and the nearby August/October spread was steady at between $10.30 and $10.50.
"There's no volume...but then New York isn't doing that much either," said one trader.
France's white sugar futures market is closed for a public holiday.
